protocol.scope: Local refinement at supplied seeds; not full-image detection or recall.
protocol.fixtures: Continuous analytic fields; distinct RGB channels; complete true-pose support; identical cached inputs across methods. Same texture and seed prefix across counts.
protocol.heldout: 12 cases: sizes160/256/512, channels1/3, counts4/16; independent texture seeds and truth poses.
protocol.edge: 8 cases: gray/RGB near-perfect, constant, frozen angle/scale, one iteration. Constant cases have no geometric accuracy; an iteration-limited solve is not expected to meet every final accuracy gate.
protocol.algorithm: CPU portable refinement versus Metal statistics plus CPU solve/verification, forced Metal polish0. Auto loads C++ policy defaults, optionally overriding explicitly supplied CLI fields.
protocol.warm_timing: Outer Python call includes routing, C ABI, dispatch/wait, solve and CPU final verification; excludes fixture/loading, constructor and post-run validation.
protocol.cold_timing: Constructor wall plus first refinement wall, including lazy Metal setup. Fresh process; driver/shader caches are not purged. Input loading and Python imports excluded.
protocol.memory: Peak RSS captured before extra reference contexts, includes Python/input loading/setup/algorithm. Owned buffers reported separately; Metal shared RAM overlaps RSS.
protocol.verification: CPU rechecks every score, independent float64 oracle checks first/last poses. Auto must exactly match selected forced backend including pose, score, stats; checks are outside timing.
protocol.accuracy: NCC>=0.8 and <=0.5px/0.5deg/1% relative scale. Local true accuracy is separate from numerical correctness.
protocol.comparison: Fastest measured backend and ratios are empirical per-case medians, not guarantees or confidence intervals.
